verification.subject: Confirm your email address – {orgName}
verification.title: Welcome to {orgName}!
verification.preheader: Please confirm your email address to activate your account.
verification.text: great to have you with us! Please briefly confirm your email address so we can send you shift reminders and updates from the organizers:
verification.securityText: This confirmation link is valid for {hours} hours.{deleteNote} If you did not enter this address yourself, you can simply ignore this email.
verification.deleteNote: Without confirmation, the account will be deleted afterwards.
verification.footerNote: You received this email because your address was registered for an account on {domain}.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password – {orgName}
passwordReset.title: Set a new password
passwordReset.text: you requested to reset the password for your account at {orgName}.
passwordReset.instructions: Click the button below to choose a new password:
passwordReset.warningText: This link is valid for {hours} hours. If you did not make this request yourself, your current password remains unchanged.
passwordReset.footerTip: Tip: With a {provider} account, you can also log in directly at any time without a separate password.

accountExists.subject: You already have an account – {orgName}
accountExists.preheader: An account already exists for your email address.
accountExists.title: You already have an account
accountExists.text: someone tried to create a new account on {orgName} with this email address. However, an account already exists for your address.
accountExists.instructions: Simply log in. If you have forgotten your password, you can reset it via the link below.
accountExists.warningText: In that case you can ignore this email. Nothing has changed with your account.

inactiveAccount.subject: Your account will be deleted – {orgName}
inactiveAccount.preheader: Your account will be deleted on {deleteOn} if you do not log in.
inactiveAccount.title: Your account will be deleted
inactiveAccount.text: you haven't used your account on {orgName} for more than two years. To ensure data is not kept longer than necessary, we will delete it on {deleteOn}.
inactiveAccount.keepAccount: Want to keep your account? Simply log in once before that date. Otherwise you don't need to do anything.
inactiveAccount.warningText: Your profile, contact information, and answers. In past events, your shift remains listed as 'Deleted person', without your name.

shiftReminder.subject: Reminder: Your shift «{shift}» begins {lead} ({event})
shiftReminder.roleSentenceResponsible: Reminder: Shortly ({lead}), your shift as shift lead for event {event} begins:
shiftReminder.roleSentenceHelper: Reminder: Shortly ({lead}), your shift for event {event} begins:
shiftReminder.preventedGuestText: Please contact the event organizers directly so your shift can be reassigned.
shiftReminder.preventedUserText: Open the shift planner and click 'Find replacement' on your shift so someone else can take your place.
shiftReminder.footerGuest: You received this reminder for your volunteer signup at «{event}».
shiftReminder.footerSettings: You received this reminder according to your settings ({lead} before shift start).
shiftReminder.footerGeneral: You received this reminder before the start of your registered shift.

shiftCancelled.subject: Shift cancelled: «{shift}» ({event})
shiftCancelled.preheader: Your shift «{shift}» for {event} has been cancelled.
shiftCancelled.title: Your shift is cancelled
shiftCancelled.text: the shift «{shift}» for event {event} was unfortunately cancelled and removed from the schedule. Your commitment for this shift is no longer required.
shiftCancelled.calloutTitle: What does this mean for you?
shiftCancelled.calloutText: You do not need to attend this shift. If you would like to take another shift instead, you can sign up again on the shift schedule.
shiftCancelled.footerNote: You received this notice because you were signed up for this shift at «{event}».

replacementTaken.subject: Replacement found: «{shift}» ({event})
replacementTaken.title: Your shift was taken over
replacementTaken.text: good news: {takenBy} has taken over your shift. You are no longer signed up for it.
replacementTaken.footerNote: You received this email because you looked for a replacement for your shift at «{event}».

cateringTokens.subject: 🎁 Don't forget your catering vouchers – {event}
cateringTokens.title: Enjoy your meal at the stand!
cateringTokens.thankYou: Thank you for your fantastic help! At “{event}”, vouchers are still waiting for you:
cateringTokens.openCount: {count, plural, one {# open voucher:} other {# open vouchers:}}
cateringTokens.instructions: Pick up your helper meal and drink at the stand before the event ends. You can easily redeem your voucher on your smartphone using the slider.
